title: At least 26 killed as minibus hits container truck near Kaziranga in Assam
dek: The head-on crash on National Highway 715 in Golaghat district also injured about 20 people. Police say the minibus was speeding through a stretch where limits apply near the national park.
author: Declaration Desk
body:
At least 26 people were killed and about 20 injured on Friday when a minibus collided head-on with a container truck on National Highway 715 near Kaziranga National Park in Assam's Golaghat district, according to reports citing district officials. Many of those on board were college students returning from classes, reports said. An executive magistrate of Golaghat district said the toll could rise.

Reports differ on the number of dead: early reports gave 23 and then 24, while later reports, including one from the national news agency, put it at 26. The district administration has not published a final list.

## What happened

The crash happened at Rangajan, near Hathikuli Tea Estate in the Kohora range of the park, according to reports. The minibus was travelling towards Nagaon, and the truck towards Upper Assam. A police official said the minibus was "running at very high speed, violating restrictions imposed near the park", and that the driver probably lost control, according to reports. The official cause has not been announced.

Nine ambulances were used to move the injured. About 20 people were referred to Jorhat Medical College and Hospital for advanced treatment and others were taken to Bokakhat Civil Hospital, according to reports. Assam's Panchayat and Rural Development Minister Atul Bora, the local MLA, went to the site.

## Response

Prime Minister Narendra Modi said he was "deeply anguished by the loss of lives in the mishap in Golaghat district of Assam" and announced ex-gratia payments from the Prime Minister's National Relief Fund of Rs 2 lakh to the family of each person killed and Rs 50,000 to each of the injured. President Droupadi Murmu, Defence Minister Rajnath Singh and Assam Governor Lakshman Prasad Acharya also expressed condolences. Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma said he was "deeply distressed".

## Background

NH-715 runs along the southern edge of Kaziranga and is the main road link between central and upper Assam. Speed limits are imposed on the stretch that passes the park to protect animals crossing between the park and the Karbi Anglong hills, especially in the monsoon. Heavy trucks share the two-lane road with buses and local traffic, and the stretch has a record of serious accidents.

## What happens next

Police are expected to register a case and examine the vehicles. The state government has not announced its own compensation or an inquiry; any such decision will be reported when it is made.
